pages.text: $(li)Click the track (a track block, or along a curve) with a locomotive, coach or wagon to put it there, facing the way you're looking.$(li)Take the $(item)Coupler$(), click one car, then the next car along (up to 5 blocks between buffers): they're drawn together.$(li)Sneak-click a car with the coupler to uncouple it.

Near the end of a line, a car goes as near where you clicked as it fits.$(br2)Cars couple at either end, facing either way, and the locomotives can be anywhere in the train: they pull or push. A train can have up to 16 cars (a server setting).$(br2)Break a car (hit it a few times) to pick it up again; what it carries spills out.
Iron ingot, chain, iron ingot, in a column.

Trains are solid: you can't walk through one, and you can stand on its roof (but get in to ride: a moving train slides out from under anyone standing on it). Cars from Reiko's Car Mod bump into trains and trams too.

A train can have several locomotives, anywhere in it and facing either way: double-head a heavy train, or put a banking engine at the back to push.$(br2)One is in charge: the one on a timetable, or else the one being driven. The others work with it, notched up the same, each adding its pull up to its own top speed, and each burning its own fuel.
pages.title: More Than One Engine
